This Quarto notebook is the canonical executable source for
`scripts/run_16s_dada2.qmd`. It runs the full denoising path on the
primer-removed reads: quality filtering, per-run error models, sample
inference, pair merging, sequence-table construction, and chimera removal. It
writes a per-sample read-retention table, because retention is the first place
a silent parameter mistake becomes visible.

```sh
bash scripts/run_qmd.sh scripts/run_16s_dada2.qmd [trimmed_dir] [output_dir] [trunc_r1] [trunc_r2]
```

Automatic execution during rendering is disabled because this workflow writes
project outputs.

```{r}
#| label: run-16s-dada2
#| echo: true
abort <- function(...) stop(sprintf(...), call. = FALSE)

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
trimmed_dir <- if (length(args) >= 1L) args[[1L]] else Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_TRIMMED_DIR")
output_dir <- if (length(args) >= 2L) args[[2L]] else Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_DADA2_DIR")
trunc_r1 <- as.integer(if (length(args) >= 3L) args[[3L]] else Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_TRUNC_LEN_R1", "260"))
trunc_r2 <- as.integer(if (length(args) >= 4L) args[[4L]] else Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_TRUNC_LEN_R2", "200"))
if (!nzchar(trimmed_dir) || !nzchar(output_dir)) {
  abort("Provide trimmed_dir and output_dir, or source config/16s_analysis_paths.sh first.")
}
if (!requireNamespace("dada2", quietly = TRUE)) abort("Package dada2 is required.")

threads <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_THREADS", "4"))
max_ee <- c(
  as.numeric(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_MAX_EE_R1", "2")),
  as.numeric(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_MAX_EE_R2", "2"))
)
min_overlap <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_MIN_OVERLAP", "20"))
learn_nbases <- as.numeric(Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_LEARN_NBASES", "1e8"))
pool <- Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_POOL", "pseudo")
if (pool %in% c("TRUE", "FALSE")) pool <- as.logical(pool)
set.seed(20260901L)

dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
filtered_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "filtered")
dir.create(filtered_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

forward <- sort(list.files(trimmed_dir, pattern = "_R1\\.trimmed\\.fastq\\.gz$", full.names = TRUE))
reverse <- sort(list.files(trimmed_dir, pattern = "_R2\\.trimmed\\.fastq\\.gz$", full.names = TRUE))
samples <- sub("_R1\\.trimmed\\.fastq\\.gz$", "", basename(forward))
if (!length(samples) || length(forward) != length(reverse)) {
  abort("Expected matched R1/R2 trimmed FASTQs in %s.", trimmed_dir)
}
if (!identical(samples, sub("_R2\\.trimmed\\.fastq\\.gz$", "", basename(reverse)))) {
  abort("Forward and reverse file names do not correspond one to one.")
}

filtered_forward <- file.path(filtered_dir, paste0(samples, "_R1.filtered.fastq.gz"))
filtered_reverse <- file.path(filtered_dir, paste0(samples, "_R2.filtered.fastq.gz"))
names(filtered_forward) <- samples
names(filtered_reverse) <- samples

cat("Filtering and trimming\n")
filter_stats <- dada2::filterAndTrim(
  fwd = forward, filt = filtered_forward,
  rev = reverse, filt.rev = filtered_reverse,
  truncLen = c(trunc_r1, trunc_r2),
  maxEE = max_ee,
  truncQ = 2,
  maxN = 0,
  rm.phix = TRUE,
  compress = TRUE,
  multithread = threads
)
rownames(filter_stats) <- samples

kept <- file.exists(filtered_forward) & file.exists(filtered_reverse)
if (!all(kept)) {
  cat(sprintf("Samples with no reads surviving the filter: %s\n",
              paste(samples[!kept], collapse = ", ")))
}
filtered_forward <- filtered_forward[kept]
filtered_reverse <- filtered_reverse[kept]
retained_samples <- samples[kept]
if (!length(retained_samples)) abort("No sample survived filtering; revisit truncation lengths.")

cat("Learning error models\n")
error_forward <- dada2::learnErrors(filtered_forward, nbases = learn_nbases,
                                   multithread = threads, randomize = TRUE)
error_reverse <- dada2::learnErrors(filtered_reverse, nbases = learn_nbases,
                                   multithread = threads, randomize = TRUE)

pdf(file.path(output_dir, "16s_error_models.pdf"), width = 9, height = 7)
print(dada2::plotErrors(error_forward, nominalQ = TRUE))
print(dada2::plotErrors(error_reverse, nominalQ = TRUE))
invisible(dev.off())

cat("Inferring sample composition\n")
dada_forward <- dada2::dada(filtered_forward, err = error_forward, pool = pool, multithread = threads)
dada_reverse <- dada2::dada(filtered_reverse, err = error_reverse, pool = pool, multithread = threads)

cat("Merging pairs\n")
merged <- dada2::mergePairs(
  dada_forward, filtered_forward,
  dada_reverse, filtered_reverse,
  minOverlap = min_overlap,
  verbose = TRUE
)

seqtab <- dada2::makeSequenceTable(merged)
rownames(seqtab) <- retained_samples

cat("Removing bimeras\n")
seqtab_nochim <- dada2::removeBimeraDenovo(
  seqtab, method = "consensus", multithread = threads, verbose = TRUE
)

get_n <- function(x) sum(dada2::getUniques(x))
as_list <- function(x, names_) if (is.list(x) && !is.null(names(x))) x else stats::setNames(list(x), names_)
dada_forward <- as_list(dada_forward, retained_samples)
dada_reverse <- as_list(dada_reverse, retained_samples)
merged <- as_list(merged, retained_samples)

retention <- data.frame(
  sample_title = retained_samples,
  input_pairs = filter_stats[retained_samples, "reads.in"],
  filtered_pairs = filter_stats[retained_samples, "reads.out"],
  denoised_forward = vapply(dada_forward[retained_samples], get_n, numeric(1)),
  denoised_reverse = vapply(dada_reverse[retained_samples], get_n, numeric(1)),
  merged_pairs = vapply(merged[retained_samples], get_n, numeric(1)),
  nonchimeric_pairs = rowSums(seqtab_nochim)[retained_samples],
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
retention$fraction_filtered <- round(retention$filtered_pairs / retention$input_pairs, 4)
retention$fraction_merged_of_filtered <- round(retention$merged_pairs / retention$filtered_pairs, 4)
retention$fraction_nonchimeric_of_merged <- round(retention$nonchimeric_pairs / retention$merged_pairs, 4)
retention$fraction_retained_overall <- round(retention$nonchimeric_pairs / retention$input_pairs, 4)

lengths_table <- as.data.frame(table(nchar(dada2::getSequences(seqtab_nochim))),
                               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(lengths_table) <- c("asv_length_bp", "asv_count")

parameters <- data.frame(
  parameter = c("trunc_len_r1", "trunc_len_r2", "max_ee_r1", "max_ee_r2", "trunc_q",
                "min_overlap", "pool", "learn_error_nbases", "chimera_method", "threads",
                "seed", "dada2_version", "r_version", "run_timestamp_utc"),
  value = c(trunc_r1, trunc_r2, max_ee[1], max_ee[2], 2, min_overlap,
            as.character(pool), format(learn_nbases, scientific = TRUE),
            "consensus", threads, 20260901,
            as.character(utils::packageVersion("dada2")),
            paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = "."),
            format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC", usetz = TRUE)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

saveRDS(seqtab_nochim, file.path(output_dir, "16s_seqtab_nochim.rds"))
saveRDS(seqtab, file.path(output_dir, "16s_seqtab_with_chimeras.rds"))
saveRDS(list(forward = error_forward, reverse = error_reverse),
        file.path(output_dir, "16s_error_models.rds"))
write.table(retention, file.path(output_dir, "16s_read_retention.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
write.table(lengths_table, file.path(output_dir, "16s_asv_length_distribution.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
write.table(parameters, file.path(output_dir, "16s_dada2_parameters.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

print(retention[, c("sample_title", "input_pairs", "nonchimeric_pairs",
                    "fraction_merged_of_filtered", "fraction_retained_overall")])
cat(sprintf("\nASVs after chimera removal: %d\n", ncol(seqtab_nochim)))
cat(sprintf("Reads retained overall: %.1f%%\n",
            100 * sum(seqtab_nochim) / sum(retention$input_pairs)))
cat(sprintf("Wrote denoising outputs to %s\n", output_dir))
cat("QC gates: merge fraction below 0.60 usually means the truncation budget is too short;\n")
cat("a chimera fraction above 0.30 of merged reads usually means residual primer bases.\n")
```
